claims.statement: Exactly four deterministic binary64 full-joint searches were freshly replayed for the governed two-letter half-skew BSSC: seed indices 0 and 12 for W=4,U=V=6 and W=8,U=V=6, each for 30,000 fixed-schedule Adam steps. The artifact preserves hashed complete JSONL per-run records, START/RESULT/END terminal transcripts, and complete terminally reported best p(w,u,v,x_1x_2) arrays as exact binary64 hexadecimal strings; these are best-encountered candidates, with their best iteration recorded, rather than an assertion that they equal the iteration-30,000 iterate. A standard-library verifier reconstructs every probability and independently recomputes the mutual-information objective; the four recorded values are 0.7232857688438716, 0.7135420139310595, 0.7232857688438569, and 0.719167250295698 bits per two uses, each below the directed threshold lower endpoint supplied by transaction 88a1004f309460f3ec1cacdae88d30f88559f9bc. This claim explicitly excludes the 44 unreplayed U=V=6 runs and includes no U=V=8 run or broad prior campaign. It is negative binary64 evidence only, not a directed objective enclosure, optimizer-completeness claim, KKT or global-optimality certificate, Marton-additivity theorem, unrestricted upper bound, or capacity converse.
